name: xr-explorer
summary:
XR Explorer turns a property into somewhere you can stand.

Instead of judging a colour from a card under shop lighting, you walk into the room and paint the actual wall. Point, pull the trigger, and that surface changes — at full size, in the light it will actually sit in.

**What you can do**

- Walk freely through every room, upstairs and down
- Repaint any single surface: walls, floors, ceilings, doors, roofs, even a garage
- Pick from sixteen architectural colours, or mix any colour on an HSV wheel
- R
